question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fasten
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fasten"** means to close or join securely; make or become fixed or closed. (बांधना)
 
 
• **Example:** Please fasten your seatbelt before the airplane takes off.
 
 
 
• **"Bolt"** refers to a metal pin or bar, in particular. Here, it means to secure or fasten with a bolt. (बोल्ट लगाना)
 
 
• **Example:** He bolted the door to ensure no one could enter.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Fasten'** is **'Bolt'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Undo** (पूर्ववत करें): To unfasten or release.
 
 
• **Example:** He began to undo his shoelaces.
 
 
 
• **Detach** (अलग करना): To separate or remove something.
 
 
• **Example:** Please detach the coupon from the booklet.
 
 
 
• **Loosen** (ढीला करना): To make or become less tight or firm.
 
 
• **Example:** She loosened the knot so she could untie the rope.
 
 

42:Tb8a,

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
